plot_spectrogram: plot a spectrogram from a numpy array and return a matplotlib figure object
init_weights: initialize convolutional layer weights with a normal distribution using a given mean and standard deviation
apply_weight_norm: apply weight normalization to all convolutional layers in a PyTorch module
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint file from disk onto a specified device and return the dictionary
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model or optimizer state dictionary to a checkpoint file on disk
